messages:
Alex: Kicking off region-by-region rollout plan for v2.3.5 — US -> EU -> APAC. Change window 01:00-06:00 UTC. Intend to pin model and config for the slice, enable auto-rollback. Can SRE confirm warm pool counts + thermal headroom for APAC?
Maria: Release notes are uploaded: https://console/release-notes/v2.3.5. No DB migrations. Changelog highlights: improved KV cache eviction, quantization fix for int8 path.
Jon: Quick capacity readout: warm pools (estimated): US 120 GPUs, EU 65 GPUs, APAC 34 GPUs. APAC thermal headroom currently ~72% nominal — recommend conservative ramp.
Hana: Proposal: US canary 1% for 15m -> 5% for 20m smoke -> 10% steady. EU follow after US steady for 30m. APAC slow-burn: start 0.5% then 2% then 6% with longer holds. Rollback triggers: error-rate increase >1.5% absolute OR p99 latency up > 350ms baseline in any slice. Quality gate: prompt-set regression >0.6% triggers pause.
Alex: Sounds good. Two operational asks: 1) pin model variant for dedicated and hosted to `rwd-model:v2.3.5-pin`. 2) Ensure deploybot has per-region capacity limits set so it won't exceed pool. Maria can you patch infra-config?
Maria: On it — patch proposed and pushed: `infra-config@abc123` (routes pinned). Added note in release meta for Dedicated customers about fallback to v2.3.4 if pin fails.
deploy-bot: Planned rollout created. Sequence: US canary -> US ramp -> EU canary -> EU ramp -> APAC slow-burn. Canary windows and throttle rules attached. Auto-rollback condition flags configured.
Jon: I'll kick off warmup prefetch and cache priming at 00:30 UTC. Warmup script will call `/internal/warmup?model=v2.3.5&region={region}` and steady-state priming to reach 60% token-cache hit.
Hana: We'll run the smoke eval suite after US 5% ramp: eval-set `release_smoke_v2.3.5`. If BLEU-style/quality metric delta > 0.6% mark, we pause and notify. Canops: @Jon @Maria @Alex be ready.
sre-bot: SRE watches enabled: thermal-sensor, GPU-utilization, OOM-count. Alert routing: #eng-oncall + paging policy. Preconfigured throttle: per-region throttle 80% of warm pool for rollout slices.
Alex: OK. Manual holdpoints: US at 5% (20m), EU at 5% (20m), APAC before any >2% increase. If any region hits CPU/GPU error spike or regression trigger we rollback to v2.3.4 for that region only.
Maria: Config commit merged: abc123 -> main. Console release card updated with rollback playbook and contact list.
deploy-bot: US canary started (slice 1%) at 1758594400. Monitoring live.
Jon: Warmup jobs started for US at 00:30 UTC. Cache warms to ~58% after first 10m.
Hana: Running smoke evals now for US 1% window. Quick check: latency and basic quality look within bounds.
deploy-bot: US ramp to 5% at 1758594500. Auto-rollback window active for 20m.
sre-bot: Observability snapshot: US p99 220ms -> stable, error-rate flat. No thermal alarms.
Hana: Smoke eval pass for US 5%. Rolling to 10% steady after hold.
Alex: Proceed EU kickoff after US steady for 30m. Maria, page EU ops when you start EU canary.
Maria: Will do. EU canary scheduled 1758598600 (approx). Adding extra throttle for APAC due to lower warm pool.
Jon: Note: APAC warm pool increase scheduled if we need >6% but prefer slow-burn. I'll be on standby to scale if jetting.
deploy-bot: EU canary scheduled and queued. APAC slow-burn policy attached. Logs and live links posted to console.
Hana: Final reminder: test dataset `stress_prompt_subset` running during all ramps to catch regressions. If quality gate trips, we rollback that region only and open a bug with severity P1.
Alex: Thanks team. On-call rotation: @Maria covers US/EU handoff, @Jon covers infra scaling, @Hana owns evals. I'll monitor rollouts and approve manual rollforward if needed.
deploy-bot: EU canary start pending at 1758598600.
sre-bot: Continuing watch. Set alert thresh: GPU thermal >85% -> immediate throttle to 0%.
Maria: EU canary kicked at scheduled time. Notifying EU ops channel.
Jon: EU warmup shows cache at 55% within 12m. APAC still in pre-warm.
Hana: EU smoke evals running. Preliminary pass.
deploy-bot: EU ramping to 5% now.
Alex: If all green after EU steady period, we start APAC slow-burn at configured cadence. Hold tight on manual ops in case of noisy neighbors.
Maria: Logs and release notes links: https://console/releases/v2.3.5 and infra commit abc123.
Jon: I'll post warmup completion + final pool numbers when APAC pre-warm finishes.
Hana: Keeping continuous evals running. If anything flags I'll call rollback and tag with `rollout/regression/v2.3.5`.
deploy-bot: EU steady. APAC slow-burn scheduled to begin in 40m.
sre-bot: All region-specific watches active. Page if you see thermal anomalies.
Alex: Great work. We'll keep this thread as the single source. If we trigger a rollback, update console playbook and include the reason code.
